title: Dose-PlanNet: Physics Based Radiotherapy Dose Prediction with Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automating prostate radiotherapy treatment planning is dosimetrically complex, particularly for extreme hypofractionated regimens. In this study, we introduce Dose-PlanNet, a physics-guided 3D deep learning architecture designed to predict dose distributions. This model's performance was evaluated on a cohort of patients treated in a prospective trial where two different dose fractionation regimens were employed. Dose-PlanNet achieved comparable target coverage ($D_{95}$), though statistical analysis revealed a marginal reduction in target homogeneity ($p<0.001$) offset. However the model achieved statistically significant improvements in high-dose organ-at-risk sparing ($p<0.001$). When evaluated against strict Prospective Randomized protocol volumetric constraints, automated plans met prespecified clinical acceptance criteria in $11$ out of $14$ Moderate Hypofraction Arm plans and $9$ out of $12$ Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy A

translated_title: Dose-PlanNet：基于物理学的深度学习放射治疗剂量预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26901v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自动化前列腺放射治疗计划在剂量学上具有复杂性，尤其对于极端低分割方案。在本研究中，我们引入了Dose-PlanNet，一种物理引导的3D深度学习架构，旨在预测剂量分布。该模型的性能在一项前瞻性试验中接受治疗的患者队列上进行了评估，该试验采用了两种不同的剂量分割方案。Dose-PlanNet实现了可比的靶区覆盖（$D_{95}$），但统计分析显示靶区均匀性略有下降（$p<0.001$）被抵消。然而，该模型在高剂量危及器官保护方面实现了统计学显著改善（$p<0.001$）。当依据严格的前瞻性随机方案体积约束进行评估时，自动化计划在14个中度低分割臂计划中有11个和12个体部立体定向放射治疗A计划中有9个满足了预设的临床接受标准。
tldr: Dose-PlanNet通过物理引导的3D深度学习架构，在保持靶区覆盖的同时，显著改善了前列腺放疗中高剂量危及器官的保护，并提高了计划对临床约束的满足率。
en_tdlr: Dose-PlanNet, a physics-guided 3D deep learning architecture, significantly improves high-dose organ-at-risk sparing in prostate radiotherapy while maintaining target coverage, enhancing clinical constraint satisfaction.
